What each line costs the pipelines (selected range)

panels.description: Total elapsed time of PR and CI runs per line. Shows where pipeline time goes; it is not agent-hours (runs may use several agents). Only PR and CI runs are split by line: a PR run by its target branch, a CI run by its source branch. PR-Publish runs started manually have no target branch and land in Unassigned. CD runs belong to environments, not lines. Agents are shared by all lines. Caution: Azure DevOps has already purged most older builds. Weekly counts show CI runs only from mid-September and PR runs only from about 8 October, so earlier weeks are incomplete and the rise over time is mostly retention, not real growth. Compare only the most recent weeks.
